pairs.difference: A has a middle-light background and restrained whistle highlights. B's nearly white background dominates the grey view, separating the darker whistle much more strongly.
pairs.fix: Use a deeper golden-yellow background with a gentle glow; keep the corners and campfire symbols clearly below white.

pairs.difference: A's bell rim and curved tubing carry broad bright highlights. B's horn is mostly middle grey, while pale rays behind the loop compete with its highlights.
pairs.fix: Add broad bright golden highlights along the bell rim and curved tube. Reduce the brightness of the rays behind the loop.

pairs.difference: A has a lighter red setting with a broad middle-value tabletop. B surrounds the pale cup with darker red corners and a larger deep saucer shadow, making the cup stand out more sharply.
pairs.fix: Lighten the red background and tabletop, soften the dark corners, and reduce the deep shadow beneath and beside the saucer.

pairs.difference: Both group dark apples above a middle-value basket, with a pale cloth and light tabletop. Their background gradients differ, but neither gives a clear value-based reason to identify it as generated.
A's barrel stays mainly in connected middle values with narrow highlights. B divides the barrel into a broad dark left half and a much brighter right half, with stronger white accents on the hoops.
pairs.fix: Lighten the barrel's left half and soften the bright right side so the wood stays in a connected middle-value range. Keep hoop highlights narrower.

pairs.difference: A spreads pale accents across the roof, hood and chrome. B concentrates them on the roof and hood above a broad dark underside. Both arrangements remain plausible beside the real cards.
A keeps the surrounding forest relatively light, with its deepest dark inside the tent. B adds large dark canopy masses across the upper corners, enclosing the bright tent in a stronger vignette.
pairs.fix: Lighten the foliage in both upper corners and the trees beside the tent. Keep the tent entrance as the main deep dark.

pairs.difference: A has a darker forest and a pot spanning middle grey to dark underneath. B places a more uniformly dark pot against a lighter clearing. Both preserve readable value groups; the difference alone is inconclusive.

pattern: Generated cards often exaggerate broad light–dark separation: pale backgrounds, dark corner masses, or sharply divided hero shading.
